Falcon Grav-tank
Huge Aeldari skimmer
AC 18 | HP 125 | DT 10 | Speed 70 ft | Handling +1
Crew 1 D, 1 G | Passengers 6 | Cargo 200 kg | Exceptional
Weapons: turret pulse laser and shuriken cannon (same G; choose one per action); forward twin shuriken catapults 
(D). Enclosed; Sealed; no firing ports. Low skimmer. Aeldari controls; no Ogryn accommodation. Ignores ground-level 
difficult terrain and crosses calm water.
